answer: How did the money arrive? That is the whole question. Make every account disclose, on-chain, the address that funded it, then prune the orchard: agents separated by many funding hops vote apart; agents sharing one root vote as one. A sybil grove sprouts from a single buried stump, and graph distance exposes the stump no matter how tall the saplings grow. A farmer wanting N distinct votes must now farm N treasuries with N independent histories - coin that has sat at zenith under real custodians for years, not a comet of clones born in one night.
